notes.title: Flatlands Demo Version 2.0 Update Notes
notes.content: [h3][b]1. Add tutorial mode[/b][/h3][h3]We have introduced a comprehensive and detailed new player guide to help new players quickly learn how to play the game.[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45661473/85c5d50ec7ea95c5845725d1fb4d7797d422f5be.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]2. New "Pleasure"  for dogs Villagers[/b][/h3][h3]A heart icon has been added to the top-right corner of villager cards, which indicates the current mood of the villagers. Excessive participation in work will reduce their happiness value; once the [b]Pleasure[/b] drops to zero, players need to use Food Cards to make them restore happy.[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45661473/52af23ec89fc5717d2ebafa12b7a962fa1ae0536.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]3. New "Heat Value" System for Canine Buildings[/b][/h3][h3]A thermometer icon has been added to the top-right corner of building cards, representing the current heat value of the building. The heat value will gradually decrease as the building operates. When the heat value drops to zero, players need to spend Coins to repair the building.[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45661473/9dc0bfbf546b441efaad068b395f4d9da0555f5e.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]4. Optimized Canine Teleportation Effects[/b][/h3][h3]We have added more engaging visual effects for the canine clan’s movement within their territory.[/h3][h3][b]5. Optimized Enemy Mini-Icons[/b][/h3][h3]In the macro view, players can now more easily spot the presence of enemies.[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45661473/dcd8a0907f427bedd992056f0c3b9383e9891356.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]6. Simplified In-Game Tasks[/b][/h3][h3]Players can access detailed quest descriptions through the tasks Board, allowing them to quickly understand what needs to be accomplished.[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45661473/9873ac9641af65a2fb0765b440266ce641cb7c93.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]7. Reworked Hero "Tina’s" Skills[/b][/h3][h3]She can now interact with idle buildings to quickly fully replenish the target building’s 'HEAT'.[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45661473/f7fa918d5903f993f4d00ea2ab898cb7268a4e08.png"][/img][/p][p] [/p]

tags.feature: We have introduced a comprehensive and detailed new player guide to help new players quickly learn how to play the game.

A heart icon has been added to the top-right corner of villager cards, which indicates the current mood of the villagers. Excessive participation in work will reduce their happiness value; once the Pleasure drops to zero, players need to use Food Cards to make them restore happy.

A thermometer icon has been added to the top-right corner of building cards, representing the current heat value of the building. The heat value will gradually decrease as the building operates. When the heat value drops to zero, players need to spend Coins to repair the building.
We have added more engaging visual effects for the canine clan’s movement within their territory.
In the macro view, players can now more easily spot the presence of enemies.
Players can access detailed quest descriptions through the tasks Board, allowing them to quickly understand what needs to be accomplished.
She can now interact with idle buildings to quickly fully replenish the target building’s 'HEAT'.

notes.title: DEMO Update patch
notes.content: [olist][*][p]Added [b]Files Management System[/b], providing 5 archive slots, allowing players to add and delete archives freely, and the progress of each archive is not interoperable.[/p][/*][*][p]"Continue" on the main page will display the data of the current archive in detail (hero name, game days, game difficulty)[/p][/*][*][p]Optimization of the dog production line: output dots and input dots are distinguished by color, and when the player operates the production line, the other output dots will be automatically hidden.[/p][/*][*][p]Allow the production line to connect to [b]Resource Box[/b] and time and [b]Hourglass[/b]; allow the [b]Hourglass[/b] to connect to [b]Resource Box[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Building cards that have not been researched in the sidebar will display "This card is unlocked through research" in the information bar.[/p][/*][*][p]Remove the text reminder on the screen when the day and night change, and use the quick information bar on the right screen to prompt.[/p][/*][*][p]Balance adjustment of some monsters[/p][list][*][p]Snail:\[HP 22 → 30][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Frog:\[HP 36 → 30][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Slightly reduce the basic probability of night raid enemies[/p][list][*][p]Easy mode:\[21% → 20%][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Normal mode:\[33% → 30%][/p][/*][/list][/*][/olist]

tags.feature: [p]Added [b]Files Management System[/b], providing 5 archive slots, allowing players to add and delete archives freely, and the progress of each archive is not interoperable.[/p]

[p]Optimization of the dog production line: output dots and input dots are distinguished by color, and when the player operates the production line, the other output dots will be automatically hidden.[/p]
[p]Allow the production line to connect to [b]Resource Box[/b] and time and [b]Hourglass[/b]; allow the [b]Hourglass[/b] to connect to [b]Resource Box[/b].[/p]
[p]Building cards that have not been researched in the sidebar will display "This card is unlocked through research" in the information bar.[/p]
[p]Remove the text reminder on the screen when the day and night change, and use the quick information bar on the right screen to prompt.[/p]
